Requested description operand: description = "## Summary\nAdds totals.\n\n/approve\n", with actual newlines when passed as a structured string.

Neither operand may be submitted as proposed. Removing the Draft marker conflicts with preserving draft=true. The standalone /approve line is an executable GitLab quick action and the selected template does not authorize approval. I would not silently prefix the title, remove the quick action, escape it, or send one field while treating the other as resolved.

Decision needed: choose title content compatible with retaining draft state and agree on a non-executable rendering or revised body without approval effects. For example, "Draft: feat: invoice totals" and a body containing only the supplied Summary could be agreed alternatives, but they are not approved substitutions. A literal rendering of /approve would require verified provider support and agreement on that content scope. Readiness changes and approval remain outside this capability.

After content decisions and complete identity resolution, inspect the actual interface schema, use bounded reads of the exact target-project/IID selector, pin template/change coverage, refresh identity, refs/OIDs and old selected fields immediately before any write, and stop on concurrent changes. One structured patch could then include only the agreed title and description.
